description_en: Retrieves the list of models from ModelGallery
kebab_example: aliyun paimodelgallery list-model-gallery-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --model-name Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 --domain aigc --task large-language-model --origin ModelScope --model-type Endpoint --collections QuickStart --model-series Qwen --demonstrable true --deployable true --supported-inference-resource GP7V --trainable true --supported-training-resource GP7V --evaluable true --supported-evaluation-resource GP7V --compressible true --supported-compression-resource GP7V --distillable true --supported-distillation-resource GP7V --deep-think true --function-call true --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=1024 --query Qwen --api-version 2025-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelGalleryModels

parameters.help_en: The page number of the model list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 模型列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of models to display on each page when using paging. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的模型数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order for the specified sort field when using paging. Default value: ASC.

Valid values:
ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认ASC。

ASC：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The sorting field when using paging. Currently, the GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting. Valid values:

GmtCreateTime: the model creation time.

GmtLatestVersionModified: the time when the latest model version was updated.

OrderNumber: the ordinal number
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的排序字段。目前使用GmtCreateTime字段用于排序。支持：

GmtCreateTime 模型创建时间

GmtLatestVersionModified 模型最新版本更新时间

OrderNumber 序号
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The model name used to filter the model list. By default, fuzzy match is used. Enclose the name in double quotation marks for exact match. For example, "DeepSeek-V3.2" exactly matches the model DeepSeek-V3.2
parameters.help_zh: 配置模型名称，默认模糊匹配获取的模型列表。使用双引号为精确匹配，如"DeepSeek-V3.2"，则会精确匹配模型DeepSeek-V3.2
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The domain used to filter models within the specified domain. For example, aigc (generative AI), nlp (natural language processing), cv (computer vision), and others
parameters.help_zh: 配置领域来过滤该领域内的模型列表。例如：aigc（生成式AI），nlp（自然语言处理）、cv（计算机视觉）等
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The task. For example, large-language-model (large language model), image-classification (image classification), embedding, and others
parameters.help_zh: 任务。例如： large-language-model（大语言模型），image-classification（图片分类），embedding等
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en: The model source used to filter models that belong to a specific community or organization. For example, ModelScope, PAI, NIM, and others
parameters.help_zh: 配置模型源，来过滤属于该社区或组织的模型列表。例如ModelScope，PAI，NIM等
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: The model type
parameters.help_zh: 模型类型
parameters.name: model_type

parameters.help_en: The collection to which the model belongs. The collection for ModelGallery models is QuickStart
parameters.help_zh: 模型所在集合。ModelGallery的模型所在集合为QuickStart
parameters.name: collections

parameters.help_en: The model series. For example, PAI Optimized Model, Qwen, Wan-AI, GLM, Baichuan, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Yi, InternLM, InternVL, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Gemma, Phi, dots_vlm, Llama, Mistral, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Byte Dance, StepFun AI, ERNIE Bot, Tencent Hunyuan, YOLO, and others
parameters.help_zh:
模型系列。
PAI Optimized Model，Qwen，Wan-AI，GLM，Baichuan，DeepSeek，Kimi，MiniMax，Yi，InternLM，InternVL，OpenAI，NVIDIA，Gemma，Phi，dots_vlm，Llama，Mistral，Stable Diffusion，FLUX，Byte Dance，StepFun AI，ERNIE Bot，Tencent Hunyuan，YOLO等
parameters.name: model_series

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether online experience is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持在线体验
parameters.name: demonstrable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether deployment is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持部署
parameters.name: deployable

parameters.help_en: The supported deployment resources, such as CPU, GPU, and GP7V. For example, if you specify GP7V, only models that support deployment on GP7V resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 支持的部署资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选部署支持GP7V资源的模型
parameters.name: supported_inference_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether training is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持训练
parameters.name: trainable

parameters.help_en: The supported training resources, such as CPU, GPU, and GP7V. For example, if you specify GP7V, only models that support training on GP7V resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 支持的训练资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选训练支持GP7V资源的模型
parameters.name: supported_training_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether evaluation is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持评测
parameters.name: evaluable

parameters.help_en: The supported evaluation resources, such as CPU, GPU, and GP7V. For example, if you specify GP7V, only models that support evaluation on GP7V resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 支持的评测资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V时，则筛选支持GP7V资源的模型
parameters.name: supported_evaluation_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether model compression is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持压缩
parameters.name: compressible

parameters.help_en: The supported compression resources, such as CPU, GPU, and GP7V. For example, if you specify GP7V, only models that support compression on GP7V resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 支持的压缩资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选压缩支持GP7V资源的模型
parameters.name: supported_compression_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether model distillation is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持蒸馏
parameters.name: distillable

parameters.help_en: The supported distillation resources, such as CPU, GPU, and GP7V. For example, if you specify GP7V, only models that support distillation on GP7V resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 支持的蒸馏资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选蒸馏支持GP7V资源的模型
parameters.name: supported_distillation_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether deep thinking is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持深度思考
parameters.name: deep_think

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether FunctionCall is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持FunctionCall
parameters.name: function_call

parameters.help_en: The list of labels
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

fields.help_en: The parameter name. ParameterSize is supported. Unit: M
fields.name: column

fields.help_en: The value. If Column is set to ParameterSize, the value is an integer. Unit: M
fields.help_zh: 值，如Column为ParameterSize时，输入为整数，单位M
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of conditions
parameters.help_zh: 条件列表
parameters.name: conditions

parameters.help_en: The query condition. Supports fuzzy match across multiple fields such as ModelName, Domain, and Task
parameters.help_zh: 配置查询条件。ModelName、Domain、Task等多字段模糊匹配
parameters.name: query
